q7.answer: Critical factors: Price (20.1%), Delivery (12.1%), Quality (5.3%), Product Info (5.0%), Fit/Size (6.7%)

q9.question: How do these behaviors differ across user segments?

q10.question: What unmet needs emerge consistently?
q10.answer: Top unmet needs: Price Transparency (20.1%), Delivery Reliability (12.1%), App Performance (71.7%), Quality Assurance (5.3%), Wishlist Features (82.8%)
